reviews.title: Battery actually lasts a day
reviews.body: Took this off the charger at 7am, still at 28% after maps, photos, and two long calls. Night mode is the reason I upgraded.

reviews.title: Fast, a bit slippery
reviews.body: Screen is excellent outdoors. The graphite finish fingerprints if you skip the case. Camera is a step up from my last midranger.

reviews.title: Commute ANC that does not hiss
reviews.body: Subway noise drops enough that I can run podcasts at 40%. Fit is secure on a jog if you use the medium tips.

reviews.title: True to size, wider toe finally
reviews.body: Came from a brand that always pinched. These feel like a 10 without going up half a size. Foam is soft on easy days and not mushy at tempo.

reviews.title: Seasoned well out of the box
reviews.body: Eggs released on night two after a quick oil wipe. Handle is nicer than the cheap lodge clone I had.

reviews.title: Pockets, finally
reviews.body: Terracotta is richer than the site photo. Runs a little long on me (5'4") but the wrap is adjustable. Viscose wrinkles in a suitcase.

reviews.title: No scent, mild tingle
reviews.body: Layers under mineral SPF without pilling. I would not call it a dramatic glow in two weeks, but texture is smoother.

reviews.title: Fanless for real work
reviews.body: Docs, Figma, and a dozen Chrome tabs, fans never spin. Keyboard is quieter than my previous 14-inch. Trackpad is huge.

reviews.title: Finished it on a flight
reviews.body: Short chapters, no manifesto energy. The 2018 case study on notification design is the part I keep quoting at work.

reviews.title: Deep seat, slow delivery
reviews.body: Sand linen looks like the photo. Seat is genuinely nap-deep. Freight took nine days longer than the estimate, which is why it is four stars.
